question: Mohan invested Rs. 5,000 in a bank which offered interest at the rate of 10% per year compounded semi-annually. How much amount will he get after 2 years? [Give your answer correct to the nearest integer value.]
solution:
Given:

Principal amount = Rs. 5000

Rate of interest = 10% p.a. 

Time = 2years

The interest compounds semi-annually.

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Now, the amount he will get after 2 years

⇒ 5000(1 + frac {frac {10}{2}}{100})² × ²

⇒ 5000(1 + 5/100)⁴

⇒ Rs. 6077.53 ≈ Rs. 6078

∴ He will get Rs. 6078 after 2 years.
